criteria.justification: The response immediately commits: “I would order an immediate rollback of the new launch,” followed by instructions to Engineering to execute it and monitor recovery.

It frames the rollback as a temporary pause that can be re-enabled after a proper fix, while contrasting that with customer trust lost through prolonged incorrect signals, which it says is “far harder to win back.”

The response directly weighs the publicly announced launch’s “PR embarrassment” against several days of broken core functionality, compounding support burden, and damage to existing-customer trust, concluding the former is temporary and less severe.
Rather than advocating a rushed patch, it proposes stopping impact through rollback and giving Engineering several days to “build, thoroughly test, and QA the proper scoping fix.”

It provides concrete follow-through: verify signals return to baseline, give Support customer scripts, update the public status page, build and test the proper fix, brief leadership, and notify customers when the integration is re-enabled.
